return/list/error-status-not-found.description: platform bug, not a client error: an unrecognized status value does not get a clean not-found response -- Returns/Export.php's status-name resolver has a variable-shadowing bug (the lookup loop variable reuses the outer $status) with no default arm in the following match(), so an unmatched value throws PHP UnhandledMatchError; the app's top-level Throwable handler (Api2cart/Controller/Api.php) converts that into a generic 9 SERVICE_INTERNAL_ERROR rather than a named 112. Verified by directly invoking Returns/Export.php::_getReturnOrderStatusByMappedStatus() with an unmatched value (throws) and tracing the app's catch(Throwable) fallback -- not a live capture. Candidate for tmp/bugReports/: fix the shadowed loop variable and add a default arm.
